{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Step 2: Correct assay_batch B values: divide by 10 to convert from µg/L to ng/mL
# Batch A is already in ng/mL, so no correction needed
df_dedup['biomarker_final_corrected'] = df_dedup['biomarker_final']
mask_batch_b = df_dedup['assay_batch'] == 'B'
df_dedup.loc[mask_batch_b, 'biomarker_final_corrected'] = df_dedup.loc[mask_batch_b, 'biomarker_final'] / 10

# Step 3: Compute the mean of the corrected biomarker_final
mean_biomarker_final = df_dedup['biomarker_final_corrected'].mean()

# Print the mean and confirm the correction was applied
print(f'Mean biomarker_final (corrected): {mean_biomarker_final}')
print(f'Number of patients after deduplication: {len(df_dedup)}')
print(f'Proportion of batch B: {df_dedup["assay_batch"].value_counts(normalize=True)["B"]:.4f}')
print(f'Batch B values before correction (first 5): {df_dedup.loc[df_dedup["assay_batch"] == "B", "biomarker_final"].head(5).tolist()}')
print(f'Batch B values after correction (first 5): {df_dedup.loc[df_dedup["assay_batch"] == "B", "biomarker_final_corrected"].head(5).tolist()}')"}
